About

The analyst behind the dashboards

About

Hi, I'm Prashant. I'm a Data Analyst with over two years of experience in MIS reporting, dashboard development, data validation and business reporting. I turn messy business data into clear, decision-ready reports that teams and clients can act on.

My day-to-day work covers daily, weekly and monthly MIS and KPI reports, built with Advanced Excel, Power Query, SQL and Power BI. I clean, validate and reconcile data from operational systems such as ICMS and POS, trace errors back to their root cause, and check the numbers before they reach a stakeholder.

By standardising recurring reports with reusable templates and automation, I improved reporting turnaround by 25%. Beyond my core role, I build interactive web dashboards in HTML, CSS and JavaScript that connect to Excel, CSV and Google Sheets, so retail and operations teams can compare stores, categories and margins on their own.

My goal is to close the gap between raw data and business decisions, so every report is accurate, easy to read and ready to act on.
